newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bill trade delayed 30 minutes - exchange.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bill trade delayed 30 minutes - exchange.

text.p: Trading in Russian government securities on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), will be delayed by about 30 minutes and should start at 11.30 a.m. (0730 GMT), MICEX said on Monday.

Trade will be extended by half an hour to make up for the delay and close at 1.30 p.m. (0930 GMT), a spokesman said, adding that technical problems had caused the delay on Russia's main exchange for government securities.
